content: Customer Shaurya Joshi called to inquire about his health policy, which he suspected had expired. Agent Neha Kapoor verified the policy (SH-123456) and confirmed it expired last month without a reminder sent. Neha offered options to either reinstate the old policy or switch to a new policy with additional dental and vision coverage. Shaurya expressed interest in the new policy and asked about the pricing details before the call concluded.

action_items: Provide pricing details for the new policy with dental and vision coverage to the customer
